name: nestbolt
description: Local fixed-sheet nesting for laser, CNC, plasma, waterjet and fabric cutting, with SVG and DXF in and out.
long_description: Import SVG or DXF parts, nest them on fixed sheets with margins, spacing, defects, rotations and mirroring, then export one SVG and one DXF per sheet from the original curves. Every layout passes an independent geometry check, and budgets are repeatable: the same inputs, budget and seed give the same layout. This bundle contains the Windows x64 server. It needs no network, listener or account. Choose an existing local workspace: Nestbolt reads and writes only inside it and never overwrites files.

tools.name: import_parts
tools.description: Import closed outlines from SVG or DXF files into a part library with exact curves, in millimetres.

tools.name: nest
tools.description: Nest library parts on fixed sheets with a repeatable budget and write the layout, report and per-sheet SVG and DXF.

tools.name: validate_layout
tools.description: Check a layout file against the parts, sheets and spacing with the independent validator.

tools.name: export_layout
tools.description: Write one SVG and one DXF per sheet for a valid layout, keeping arcs and curves.

tools.name: estimate_sheets
tools.description: Give a fast lower bound on sheets from net part area; it is never a layout.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Existing local folder inside which Nestbolt reads drawings and writes libraries, layouts and exports. Nests go to nestbolt/runs unless you name another folder. Startup creates nothing. Workspace checks are not an OS sandbox.
